title: How do I create an office account
question: How do I create an office account?
answer: Choose Create account on the sign-in screen and enter your name, an email from an allowed office domain, and a password. A new account waits for approval before the app opens. Help opens only after you are signed in and approved, so if you are stuck before that, ask an admin of your office's Mirsal.
looks_like: Sign in to Mirsal has Create account and Forgot password links.
